classification.calibration: preflight and bounded smoke checks only; never retained as performance evidence
classification.final_controlled_measurement: not authorized until a later protocol is pre-registered after pilot review
classification.pilot: exploratory retained evidence used only to decide whether the next size should be proposed

reference_policy.barnes_hut: full Direct reference only when admitted by the unchanged interaction and memory budgets
reference_policy.direct: no redundant reference; the Direct solver configuration remains subject to the same work cap
reference_policy.sampled: not implemented or used in this pilot; any future sampled reference requires an explicit sampled label, deterministic indices, sample size, and separate metrics

stop_rules.accuracy_failure: publish the completed pilot with a failed accuracy gate and do not authorize a larger N
stop_rules.direct_rejection: retain an explicit skipped row; never increase the interaction cap or substitute Barnes-Hut
stop_rules.nonfinite_or_execution_failure: do not publish a completed run and do not execute a larger N
stop_rules.resource_rejection: retain an explicit skipped row and do not automatically raise a limit
stop_rules.scale_progression: this task stops after N=8192 regardless of outcome
